findings.reader_payoff: The four repetitions become visible as recurring gates around distinct acts: the verse depicts enabled power while keeping its source and dependence in view.
findings.containment: This deepens the focus's attribution of the acts; it does not cancel the miracles or settle whether the repeated permission is only emphatic attribution.
